settings.text:
VASSILISDESIGN is an independent design studio in Greece, working with clients in Greece, the United States and the UK.

We let typography and composition carry the message, and we adapt the approach to each brand, product and audience instead of repeating one style.

Hands-on experience in print, packaging production and colour separation, together with in-house web development, means every idea is designed to be made.
